goal: Implement Admin management APIs for Historical Events (CRUD + publish/archive, public stays read-only published) and Lessons (create/list/get/update metadata/update draft/archive) plus read-only Lesson Template list/get. All admin endpoints require CONTENT_ADMIN; LEARNER -> 403; unauthenticated -> 401. Follows Flyway V1-V4 schema, no destructive changes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Admin event endpoints /api/v1/admin/events: create, list (pagination+search+status filter), detail, update metadata, publish, archive. Validation + valid status transitions enforced; referenced events cannot be unsafely deleted; archive preferred over delete.

Admin lesson endpoints /api/v1/admin/lessons: create (linked to event + valid template), list (pagination+filter), detail, update metadata, update draft (JSONB), archive. Published lesson_versions snapshots are immutable; draft edit preserves current published version.
Read-only lesson template endpoints: list enabled, get detail/config. No template editing.
Authorization: admin endpoints require CONTENT_ADMIN; LEARNER -> 403; unauthenticated -> 401; public GET /api/v1/events* unchanged and still permitAll (published only).

Integrity: FK integrity, consistent status transitions, tx boundaries, optimistic locking (@Version) on entities touched by concurrent update; no destructive changes to V1-V4; any new field/constraint via new migration.

Tests cover: event CRUD + transitions, lesson create + draft edit, event-lesson FK validation, invalid template refs, JSONB persistence, admin auth, learner 403, public API backward-compat, concurrent update (optimistic lock), existing auth tests stay green.
mvnw verify green locally (Docker up) or NOT VERIFIED honestly; no fake data/mocks to pass; docs/API_SPEC updated; no secrets committed.

nextAction: Code-reviewer report -> fix findings -> commit. mvnw verify already green locally (85 tests, 0 failures) with Docker up.
